# Little Jem

## Overview

- **Age:** 13 years old  <sub>[v5 c3 P8](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0008)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v4 c34 P23](../source/v04-c34.md#nw-v04-c34-p0023), [v5 c3 P8](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0008)</sub>
- **Origin:** The House of Dreams, Four Winds  <sub>[v4 c2 P20](../source/v04-c02.md#nw-v04-c02-p0020), [v5 c3 P8](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0008), [v5 c4 P46](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0046)</sub>
- **Role:** Student  <sub>[v5 c3 P14](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0014), [v5 c23 P49](../source/v05-c23.md#nw-v05-c23-p0049)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Little Jem  <sub>[v4 c35 P4](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0004), [v5 c3 P8](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0008)</sub>; Jem  <sub>[v5 c2 P1](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0001), [v5 c3 P8](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0008)</sub>

## Appearance

Little Jem has curly red hair like his mother's, and frank, steady hazel eyes like his father's. He has his mother's fine nose, his father's humorous mouth, and ears that uniquely satisfy Susan. As a thirteen-year-old boy, he grows to be a tall, sturdy, and splendid chap with an open brow and fearless eyes.

_Sources: [v5 c3 P8](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0008), [v5 c3 P11](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0011), [v5 c35 P19](../source/v05-c35.md#nw-v05-c35-p0019)_

## Personality

Jem is a sturdy, reliable, and fair-minded boy who never breaks a promise. He is not a great talker, preferring action and personal investigation over taking things on faith. Broadly knowledgeable about nature and woodcraft, he acts as a leader and chieftain among his schoolmates and peers. He holds a strong desire to become a soldier or general and see great battles.

_Sources: [v5 c3 P11](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0011), [v5 c3 P14](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0014), [v5 c7 P31](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0031), [v5 c23 P66](../source/v05-c23.md#nw-v05-c23-p0066), [v5 c35 P11](../source/v05-c35.md#nw-v05-c35-p0011), [v5 c35 P19](../source/v05-c35.md#nw-v05-c35-p0019)_

## History

Jem was born at the House of Dreams in Four Winds, named James Matthew after Captain Jim Boyd and Matthew Cuthbert. During his infancy, his family relocated to Ingleside in Glen St. Mary, where he grew up alongside five younger siblings. As the eldest, he became a favorite of Marilla Cuthbert during visits to Avonlea, though he maintained a standing feud with Susan Baker over her insistence on calling him 'Little Jem.' He established himself as a leader among the children at school and in Rainbow Valley, where he frequently cooked meals, played games, and explored the natural surroundings. When the Meredith children moved to the Glen manse, Jem quickly befriended them and later suggested the creation of their Good-Conduct Club. As he entered his teens, he dedicated his time to studying for the entrance examinations to Queen's Academy, ultimately departing for Charlottetown to continue his education.

_Sources: [v4 c34 P23](../source/v04-c34.md#nw-v04-c34-p0023), [v4 c40 P58](../source/v04-c40.md#nw-v04-c40-p0058), [v5 c1 P3](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0003), [v5 c2 P1](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0001), [v5 c2 P4](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0004), [v5 c3 P7](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0007), [v5 c3 P8](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0008), [v5 c3 P14](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0014), [v5 c4 P45](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0045), [v5 c23 P49](../source/v05-c23.md#nw-v05-c23-p0049), [v5 c23 P54](../source/v05-c23.md#nw-v05-c23-p0054), [v5 c29 P1](../source/v05-c29.md#nw-v05-c29-p0001), [v5 c35 P9](../source/v05-c35.md#nw-v05-c35-p0009)_
